visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white engraving depicting a tropical outdoor scene where two men in Western-style suits are interacting with two local men wearing turbans and traditional clothing. A large elephant stands in the background near palm trees and dense foliage. The composition is a detailed line engraving typical of 19th-century book illustrations.
visualDescription.visualObjectsEn: Elephant, palm trees, dense tropical vegetation, top hat held by one of the men, walking stick, turbans, long robes, Western-style frock coats, trousers.
visualDescription.recognizableCharactersOrPeopleEn: Two men dressed in 19th-century Western formal attire (suits and coats) and two men dressed in traditional South Asian or Middle Eastern attire including turbans and robes.
visualDescription.uncertaintyNotes: The specific identities of the individuals and the exact geographical location are not explicitly stated in the image, though the attire and the elephant suggest a South Asian setting. The engraving style is characteristic of 19th-century European illustration, but the specific artist or publication cannot be confirmed from the image alone.

suggestedMatch.exactSourceQuotation: The guide unloosed the elephant and led him into a thicket, at the same time asking the travellers not to stir. He held himself ready to bestride the animal at a moment’s notice, should flight become necessary; but he evidently thought that the procession of the faithful would pass without perceiving them amid the thick foliage, in which they were wholly concealed.
suggestedMatch.modelRationaleNotVerified: The engraving depicts an elephant in a tropical setting with men in Western attire and local guides, which aligns perfectly with the narrative context of Chapter 12 where the guide leads the travelers (Fogg and Passepartout) into a thicket with an elephant to hide from a procession.
suggestedMatch.suggestedAltArNotApproved: An engraving showing an elephant in a tropical forest with two Western men and local guides, illustrating a scene of concealment in the jungle.

visualCrosscheck.specificVisibleEvidenceNotHumanVerified: The engraving clearly shows the guide (in traditional attire and turban) standing near an elephant in a thicket, instructing the travellers (two gentlemen in Western suits, one holding a hat and stick) to stay put while hiding among the dense tropical foliage, perfectly matching the described scene.
